title: PRAY THIS BEFORE 6AM AND CONTROL YOUR ENTIRE DAY
text: Hallelujah. >> Hallelujah. Glory to God. I want you to lift your voice right now. Wherever you are, whether you are watching this at midnight, whether it's 3:00 a.m., whether it's 4:00 a.m., I want you to lift your voice and just begin to worship the Lord. Don't wait for me. Don't wait for anybody. Just lift your voice and say, "Jesus, I worship you. Jesus, I honor you. Lord, I magnify your name." Come on, lift that voice. Father, we worship you. Ancient of days, we bow before you. The one who was, who is, and who is to come, the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last. We worship you, Lord. We worship you. There is none like you, Father. In the heavens and in the earth, there is none like you. You are God alone. You are the Lord. You are the King of glory. Hallelujah. If you are in this atmosphere right now, I want you to know that God is about to do something unusual. The Holy Spirit is here. I can feel him. I can sense him moving. There's a weight in this atmosphere that is not ordinary. Something is about to happen to your life tonight. Something is about to shift in your destiny. Before I go further, I want you to do something. I want you to share this message right now. Don't wait. Share it to your WhatsApp status. Share it to someone who needs it. There is a man somewhere. There is a woman somewhere whose life is about to change because you chose to be obedient. God might use you as an instrument to transform another person's destiny. That simple act of sharing might be the seed that unlocks the greatest miracle of your life. Do it now. Share this word. Come on, let's worship. Spirit of the living God, fall aresh on me. Spirit of the living God, fall aresh on me. Melt me, mold me, fill me, use me. Spirit of the living God, fall aresh on me. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. I worship you, Lord. I worship you. You are worthy, Father. You are worthy. There is no one like you in all the earth. There is no one like you in all the heavens. Angels bow before you. Saraphim cry holy. Cherubim worship day and night. And yet you chose to hear our prayer. And yet you chose to visit this atmosphere. We are grateful Lord. We are grateful. Come on, worship him. Worship him with everything in you. Worship him with your whole heart. This is not a performance. This is not religion. This is communion. This is fellowship. This is a son or a daughter coming before a father who loves them unconditionally. Holy Spirit, you are welcome in this place. Move as you will. Speak as you will. Touch as you will. Heal as you will. Deliver as you will. We surrender to you completely. Hallelujah. Now, I want you to receive this in your spirit. The title of this ministration is pray this before 6:00 a.m. and control your entire day. I want you to understand something profound. The morning hours are not ordinary hours. They are not just the beginning of a new day. They are gateways. They are portals. They are windows through which destinies are written and rewritten. Listen to me carefully. The reason why many believers are tossed around by the events of the day is because they have not learned to take spiritual authority over the day before the day begins. You wake up at 7:00 a.m. You wake up at 8:00 a.m. By that time, the enemy has already held meetings concerning your life. By that time, assignments have already been released against you. By that time, arrows have already been fired. And then you wonder why your day is filled with frustration, confusion, disappointment, and failure. But I have come to announce to somebody tonight that season is over. You will learn to control your day. You will learn to dictate the outcome of your day. You will learn to prophesy into your day before the sun rises. and everything that does not align with the will of God for your life will bow. Psalm 5:3 says, "My voice shall doubt here in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." David understood something. He said, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, not in the afternoon, not in the evening, in the morning." There is something about the morning hours that gives your voice priority in the courts of heaven. When you pray in the morning, you are not reacting to the day. You are creating the day. When you pray in the morning, you are not responding to circumstances. You are engineering circumstances. When you pray in the morning, you are not a victim, you are a victor. You are not running, you are ruling. Mark 1:35 says, "And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed." This is Jesus, the son of God, the one through whom all things were made, the one who has all power in heaven and on earth. And yet he rose up a great while before day to pray. If Jesus needed to pray before the day began, how much more do you and I need to pray? Don't let anyone deceive you. Prayer is not optional for the believer. It is oxygen. It is life. It is power. Without prayer, you are defenseless. Without prayer, you are vulnerable. Without prayer, the enemy has access to your life, your family, your finances, your health, your destiny. But tonight, something is shifting. The Holy Spirit is releasing a grace upon you, a grace to rise, a grace to pray, a grace to take authority, a grace to control your day before the day controls you. Can I prophesy to somebody? I see a man. I see a woman who has been struggling to wake up early to pray. Every time you set your alarm, something happens. You're tired. You're weak. You're distracted. You press snooze. You go back to sleep. And by the time you wake up, the day has already begun without you. But I decree tonight that slumber breaks, that heaviness breaks, that spirit of laziness breaks. From this night, you will rise like an eagle. You will mount up with wings. You will SOAR IN PRAYER. THE FIRE OF THE HOLY Ghost will wake you up before your alarm. The burden of intercession will pull you out of bed. You will not miss your morning altar. You will not miss your place of prayer. Your destiny depends on it. Your family depends ON IT. YOUR GENERATION DEPENDS on it. And you will not fail them. Receive that grace right now in the name of Jesus. Hallelujah. Now let me teach you something. The Bible says in Lamentations 3 22 to 23, it is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness. His mercies are new every morning, not every evening, not every afternoon, every morning. There is a fresh supply of mercy that is released every morning. There is a fresh supply of grace that is released every morning. There is a fresh supply of favor that is released every morning. But you must position yourself to receive it. Imagine a bank that opens at 6:00 a.m. and distributes free money to whoever shows up first. Imagine they do this every single day. Would you not wake up early? Would you not be there before the doors open? Would you not position yourself to receive? Heaven is distributing mercy every morning. Heaven is distributing grace every morning. Heaven is distributing favor every morning. Heaven is distributing breakthroughs every morning. But only those who are awake receive. Only those who are positioned receive. Only those who are praying receive. Don't sleep through your season. Don't sleep through your miracle. Don't sleep through your breakthrough. Proverbs 81 17 says, "I love them that love me, and those that seek me early shall find me." Those that seek me early shall find me. There is a promise attached to seeking God early, you will find him. You will encounter him. You will experience him. Not just hear about him, not just read about him, but find him. Encounter him, experience him. And when you find God in the morning, you find everything. You find direction, you find wisdom, you find strength, you find protection, you find provision, you find healing, you find deliverance, you find favor, you find peace. Seek him early. Find him and control your day. Now, I want to give you a pattern. I want to give you a structure because many people want to pray in the morning but they don't know what to pray. They wake up and they are confused. They start praying and they run out of words in 5 minutes. They lose focus. They get distracted and they give up. But tonight the Holy Spirit is going to teach you. He's going to give you a framework. He's going to give you weapons. He's going to arm you for battle. Genesis 1:3 says, "And God said, let there be light, and there was light." In the beginning, when darkness covered the face of the deep, God did not complain about the darkness. He did not analyze the darkness. He did not discuss the darkness. He spoke. He said, "Let there be light." And there was light. Your mouth is a weapon. Your words are weapons. When you wake up in the morning before the sun rises, your first assignment is to speak. Speak over your day. Speak over your family. Speak over your finances. Speak over your health. Speak over your destiny. Speak over your nation. The Bible says in Job 22:28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." You have been given the power to decree, to declare, to establish. When you speak in the morning, you are establishing the agenda for your day. You are writing the script for your day. You are determining the outcome of your day. The enemy also knows this principle. That's why he tries to pollute your morning with bad news, with negative thoughts, with anxiety, with fear. He wants to control your day before you control it. He wants to set the agenda before you set it. He wants to write the script before you write it. But you are not ignorant of his devices. You will wake up before he does. You will speak before he does. You will decree before he releases his arrows. And by the time the day begins, your victory is already established. Your success is already written. Your breakthrough is already sealed. Come on, let's begin to pray. Father, I thank you for this revelation. I thank you for opening the eyes of my understanding. I thank you for showing me the power of the morning hours. Now Lord, I ask that you release upon me a fresh grace to pray, a fresh grace to seek you early, a fresh grace to control my day in the name of Jesus. I receive that grace now. I receive the fire of the Holy Ghost that compels me to pray. I receive the burden of intercession that pulls me out of bed. I received the discipline of a soldier that keeps me on my knees from this day. My mornings belong to God. My mornings belong to prayer. My mornings belong to prophecy. Hallelujah. Now, I want you to pray this prayer with me. This is the prayer you will pray before 6:00 a.m. This is the prayer that will control your day. This is the prayer that will shift your destiny. But before we pray, I want you to prepare your heart. This is not casual. This is warfare. This is not religious activity. This is spiritual violence. Matthew 11:12 says, "And from the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force. The violent take it by force." Not the gentle, not the passive, not the lukewarm, the violent. Those who rise up with holy aggression. Those who refuse to accept defeat. THOSE WHO FIGHT in prayer until they win. Those who don't give up. Those who don't BOW DOWN. THOSE WHO DON'T SURRENDER. Be violent tonight. BE AGGRESSIVE TONIGHT. FIGHT FOR YOUR DESTINY TONIGHT. FIGHT FOR YOUR FAMILY TONIGHT. FIGHT FOR YOUR breakthrough tonight. Here we go. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I take authority over this day. I take authority over every second, every minute, every hour. I decree that this day is blessed. This day is prosperous. This day is favored by the blood of Jesus. I cancel every evil agenda programmed against me today. Every trap set for my feet, I dismantle it. Every arrow released against my life, I send it back to the sender. Every ambush prepared against my destiny, I scatter it by fire. Father, order my steps today. Let your angels go before me. Let them prepare my way. Let them remove every obstacle. Let them destroy every hindrance. Let them silence every enemy. I declare that today I will encounter divine opportunities. I will meet the right people. I will be at the right place at the right time. Doors that have been shut against me shall open. Gates of brass shall be broken. Bars of iron shall be cut in pieces. The Bible says in Isaiah 45:2, "I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron. Father, go before me today. Make my crooked places straight. Break every gate of brass. CUT EVERY BAR OF IRON. Today I will walk in favor. Favor with God, favor with man, unmmerited favor, unusual favor, undeniable favor. Today I will experience supernatural provision. Every financial need shall be met. Every door of abundance shall open. The resources for my assignment shall locate me. Today I declare divine health over my body. No sickness, no disease, no infirmity. My body is the temple of the Holy Ghost. It is not a habitat for sickness. It is not a dwelling place for pain. By the stripes of Jesus, I am healed. I apply the stripes of Jesus to my body, to my blood, to my organs, to my systems, to my bones, to my flesh. Healing flows to me. HEALTH IS MY PORTION. STRENGTH is my inheritance. Today I declare peace over my mind. No anxiety, no fear, no depression, no confusion. The peace of God that passes all understanding guards my heart and my mind through Christ Jesus. The Bible says in Philippians 4:7, "And the peace of God which passes all understanding shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus." Peace is my portion. My mind is at rest. My heart is at rest. No matter what happens today, I will not be moved. I will not be shaken. I will not be troubled. Hallelujah. Now, let's go deeper. I want to deal with the forces that try to steal, kill, and destroy your day. Jesus said in John 10:10, "The thief cometh not, but for to steal and to kill and to destroy. I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly." There is a thief. His name is Satan. And he comes to steal your time, to steal your joy, to steal your peace, to steal your health, to steal your finances, to steal your relationships, to steal your destiny. But tonight, we're taking back everything the thief has stolen. We are recovering all. Proverbs 6:es 30-31 says, "Men do not despise a thief. Isaiah 53:es 4 to 5 says, "Surely he had borne our griefs and carried our sorrows. Yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted. But he was wounded for our transgressions. He was bruised for our iniquities. The chastisement of our peace was upon him and with his stripes we are healed. Healing is part of your redemption package. When Jesus died, he paid for your salvation and your healing. You don't have to beg for healing. You only have to receive it. Right now, I want you to place your hand wherever there is pain in your body. Wherever there is discomfort, wherever there is sickness, place your hand there in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I command healing to flow into your body right now. Every cancer, I command you to die. Every tumor, I command you to shrink and disappear. Every infection, I command you to leave. Every inflammation, I command you to subside. Every disease, I command YOU TO GO. EVERY abnormality I command you to be normalized. I speak to organs. Liver function properly, kidneys function properly, heart function properly, lungs function properly, PANCREAS FUNCTION PROPERLY, BRAIN FUNCTION PROPERLY. EVERY ORGAN IN YOUR body receive the healing power of the Holy Ghost. I speak to systems, immune system be strengthened. Nervous system be restored. Digestive system be healed. Circulatory system be regulated. Endocrine system be balanced. Reproductive system be whole. I speak to bones. Every broken bone be mended. Every weak bone be strengthened. Every bone with disease receive healing. Osteoporosis leave now. ARTHRITIS LEAVE NOW. EVERY AFFLICTION OF the bones leave now. I speak to blood. Every blood disease leave. Leukemia leave. Sickle cell leave. HIV leave. Hepatitis leave. EVERY contamination in the blood be cleansed by the blood of Jesus. I speak to eyes. Cataracts leave. Glaucoma leave. Blindness leave. Every rash, EVERY IRRITATION, EVERY CONDITION, LEAVE. Now I speak to minds. Depression, leave. Anxiety, leave. BIPOLAR DISORDER, BE BALANCED. SCHIZOPHRENIA, LEAVE. PTSD, LEAVE. EVERY MENTAL AFFLICTION, EVERY psychological torment, live now. The Bible says in 3 John verse 2, "Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth." God wishes above all things for you to be in health. It is his desire. It is his will. It is his plan. Receive your healing now. Receive your wholeness now. Receive your restoration now. Hallelujah. Glory to God. And finally, stay connected to the presence of God. Not just when there's a problem every day. Worship him. Study his word. Pray without ceasing. Fellowship with other believers. Let your relationship with him be the foundation of everything else. This is the key to controlling your day. It's not a formula. It's a relationship. When you start your day with God, everything else falls into place. When you begin in his presence, you move in his power. When you start in worship, you end in victory. Remember this. Remember tonight. Remember what you felt. Remember what you received. The Lord bless you. The Lord keep you. The Lord establish you. The Lord prosper you. The Lord exalt you. The Lord fulfill every promise he's made to you in Jesus name. Amen.
